text:
reena: Postmortem follow-up for INC-345: recurring cache evictions. We need owners, short timelines, and runbook/playbook edits. No full meeting unless blockers.
sasha: I'll own the playbook escalation paragraph and sample pager payload.
omar: I'll take the canary rollout and verification checklist. ETA 10 days for full verification.
maya: I'll PR the runbook edits and include exact diagnostic + rollback commands. Aiming for 48h.
sasha: Good. Make the TTL change feature-flagged and include the feature-flag revert command in the runbook.
maya: Adding quick triage commands now:
```
# evictions in last 10m
curl -s http://metrics.internal/query?expr=rate(cache_evictions_total[10m])
# top keys by lowest TTL
redis-cli -h cache.prod --raw keys "session:*" | xargs -n1 -I{} sh -c 'printf "%s\t" {} && redis-cli -h cache.prod ttl {}' | sort -k2 -n | head -n 20
```
omar: Canary plan: deploy to 5% pods, monitor 5m windows for evictions and p95 latency. Rollback if evictions > 10/min OR p95 +25%. I'll add kubectl snippets to the checklist.
ops-bot: Created tasks: INC-345-FU-201 (owner: maya), INC-345-FU-202 (owner: omar), INC-345-FU-203 (owner: sasha). Links: https://tracker/INC-345-FU-201
sasha: Playbook change: add "repeat evictions" path: if same cluster reports 2 eviction incidents within 7 days -> escalate to oncall-sre + oncall-platform and open recurring-review. Include sample pager: "[INC-345] recurring cache evictions in cluster X — paging oncall-sre".
maya: Rollback snippet for runbook:
```
# disable flag and undo k8s rollout
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $MGMT" https://flags.internal/api/ttl_experiment -d '{"enabled":false}'
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/cache-proxy --to-revision=previous
```
omar: Also adding a short cleanup script in case experiment keys were written during canary.
ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up check-in in 5 days for INC-345-FU-201.
sasha: Recap: INC-345-FU-201 (maya) runbook PR + config diff (48h), INC-345-FU-202 (omar) canary + verification (canary Tue), INC-345-FU-203 (sasha) playbook escalation text (EOD Fri). Reopen thread if blockers. :white_check_mark:
